entities.summary: The Manchukuo Imperial Army was the army of Manchukuo, a puppet state established by the Empire of Japan in Manchuria. Established in 1932, it was primarily involved in counterinsurgency operations against Communist and Kuomintang guerrillas in Manchukuo, and also fought against the Red Army on several occasions. Initially consisting of National Revolutionary Army deserters who had served under Zhang Xueliang and were recruited en masse after the Japanese invasion of Manchuria, the Manchukuo Imperial Army was gradually expanded using a mixture of volunteers and conscripts.
